notes.title: Terrarium v1.1.1 Bug fixes and QOL patch
notes.notes:
[b]**Added Features**[/b]
-Can now Duplicate Props, Copying their Size and Rotation
-Magnetize can now be held down to show you where the prop is going to land with a circle

[b]**Functional Changes**[/b]
-Rotation as been changed, R and T now tilt the prop left or right based on the camera angle. Q and E still rotates based on the Props Y-Axis but was reversed, think of pushing the prop towards that direction (Q pushes the nearest part to your left, E is the opposite)
  --We need user Feedback on new rotation methods, if it's annoying you or if you prefer it better. Please let us know! Apologies for such a vicious change.
-You can now Magnetize to the bottom of terrain! it works by shooting a raycast up first, THEN, shoots a raycast down if it doesn't hit anything

[b]**BUGS?**[/b]
-placement sound apparently plays sometimes

[b]**BUG FIXES**[/b]
-When picking up props, controller didn't match the original prop rotation
-"Pick Up" prompt said "Place" when you have a prop in queue
-Some pops had Magnetize points far below it (Just know those props shuffled positions in your bottles)
-when in fullscreen mode, going into settings activated Borderless Fullscreen mode instead (Might still happen. Please tell us the steps you did to have it occured)
-Magnetize shot perpendicular from the cursors "bottom", so rotating the cursor 90 degs to the left, shot the raycast to the right. It now ALWAYS shoots up and down.

[b]**QOL**[/b]
-Controller speed is renamed Move/Resize Speed
-Allow people to type in Rotation Speed and Move/Resize Speed for finer tuning
-Scale Speed now says whether its on or off when hovering over symbol
-You can make objects even smaller now
-Small and Medium Props can now be scaled a bit bigger. Mushrooms the size of houses!
-When you place a prop, your cursor's rotation no longer resets and keeps the previous rotation


If you come across any bugs or if your save file breaks, we will try to trouble shoot and save your dioramas from destruction. Come down to our discord server, join in and talk with others that also enjoy terrarium and see updates for our future games!
[url=https://discord.gg/yjmJVrRWRg]Traveler Studio's Discord Link[/url]

notes.title: Rolled Back Update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We apologize for the inconvenience caused between the times 7 pm PST to 10 pm PST on Jan 26, 2025. We are learning to push updates onto steam and ran into a couple of rather... Mountainous issues.

[b]If you updated during that time; Please update your game now. This should revert the game to the previous 1.0.0 version. [/b]

The recent update was to fix some bugs and redo the tutorial, but unfortunately how we save bottles doesn't work for new updates. We rolled back the update until we can find a way to save everyone's beautiful dioramas.

For those who witnessed instant crashing upon launching the game, please let us know if you continue to see these issues; we would be happy to help see them resolved.

As always we are continuing to learn how to provide the best experience for our players when playing our games and we appreciate your patience.

Happy Building!


For bug reports or to see our progress with Terrarium and future games. Feel free to join our discord and chat with the developers!
[b][url=https://discord.gg/yjmJVrRWRg]Traveler Studios Discord Link[/url][/b]
